reason: Both catch the same core flaws, but A asks what Carla changed after the missed deadlines, which would draw out her miss-the-10th-and-the-month-is-free guarantee, and it moves the accountant-savings proof next to the $199 price, the main objection for a reader paying her cousin $600 a year. B's advice on the opening and stacked disclaimers is sound but more general, and its questions are less likely to surface the hidden facts.
